attempts.prompt: Generate exactly ONE finished educational causal-sequence raster image with a wide landscape horizontal triptych. Exactly THREE equal side by side panels separated by generous plain white gutters, no border. Every element is comfortably in frame with white margins. Crisp flat children's educational illustration in solid colors and dark outlines, one friendly recognizable anthropomorphic rabbit with functional animal paws, species traits and no extra limbs. Same single agent, facial identity, clothing, sizes, scale, white backdrop, camera angle, furniture and objects in all three panels. Keep important objects large and sharply legible while keeping all three full actors visible. Catalan content specification, translate visually: LEFT (initial state): Una làmpada de taula està apagada i el dit encara és separat del commutador mecànic visible al peu. CENTER (explicit physical mechanism): Prem el commutador amb el dit fins que bascula. S’encén la font dins la pantalla i es comença a veure el cercle de llum. RIGHT (consequence): El dit s’aparta. El commutador resta en la nova posició i la llum incideix sobre la mateixa taula. Count and continuity: Una làmpada de peu rodó, un commutador integrat i una pantalla. Mateixa llum ambiental. Use a large unlabeled mechanical rocker switch integral with lamp circular base, angled so the two positions are readable. A warm luminous patch on white tabletop and visibly glowing matte underside of shade distinguish ON. Maintain studio lighting unchanged. Switch is large enough to read, lamp is the only light object. No words, letters, digits, arrows, motion-line marks, numbers, branding or watermark. Grounded shapes and correct contact and proportions, white backdrop.
attempts.review: El dit toca l’extrem que ja era abaixat i el commutador manté la inclinació a les tres vinyetes. Cal mostrar la basculació que encén el llum.

attempts.prompt: Generate exactly one finished raster illustration for classroom causal reasoning. Landscape canvas, three equally wide side-by-side panels with broad pure white gutters and generous outer margins. Flat 2D educational picture book art of one friendly recognizable anthropomorphic rabbit, solid colors, clean outlines, correct functional anatomy and no additional human arms. Same agent and exact fixed 3/4 camera, light direction, scene layout, object sizes and geometry across the panels. Maximize legibility of the contact point and result while leaving margins around every object and body. Use minimal supports and white backdrop. Catalan brief, interpret in the pictures: LEFT state of departure: Una làmpada de taula està apagada i el dit encara és separat del commutador mecànic visible al peu. CENTER explicit physical cause: Prem el commutador amb el dit fins que bascula. S’encén la font dins la pantalla i es comença a veure el cercle de llum. RIGHT consequence: El dit s’aparta. El commutador resta en la nova posició i la llum incideix sobre la mateixa taula. Continuity and object accounting: Una làmpada de peu rodó, un commutador integrat i una pantalla. Mateixa llum ambiental. Show a large mechanical gray rocker on the circular lamp base, with no lettering, symbols or embossing; shoot from side-front so it is readable. LEFT the side nearer the pointing finger is conspicuously HIGH and the far side is DOWN. CENTER the finger presses the formerly HIGH side down into the base, and the far side is now HIGH. RIGHT maintain that exact flipped slope, hand withdrawn, lamp remains on. The only lighting change is the underside of the lampshade and warm spill on table. No graphic arrows, movement lines, words, letters, numbers, signage, logo or watermark. Keep all object edges, hand contact and supports physically coherent. Three panels, readable left to right.
attempts.review: El perfil del commutador es capgira sota el dit. El llum s’encén en el moment del contacte i continua encès amb el nou estat del commutador.
